mapper.select: SELECT k.category, k.name, count(sk.kwd_no) AS count_keyword FROM selected_keyword sk JOIN ( SELECT ik.NO, ik.name, ic.name AS category FROM interest_keyword ik JOIN interest_category ic ON ik.cate_no = ic.NO WHERE ik.is_active = 1 AND ic.is_active = 1 ) k ON sk.kwd_no = k.NO WHERE sk.created_at >= DATE_SUB(now(), interval 1 month) GROUP BY k.no ORDER BY count_keyword DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT c.no, c.name, k.no AS k_no, k.name AS k_name, k.description AS k_description FROM interest_category AS c JOIN interest_keyword AS k ON k.cate_no = c.no WHERE c.is_active = 1 AND k.is_active = 1
